svg.title: Planned Umpqua Basin thermal classification (field sampling not yet conducted)
svg.desc: Map of the Umpqua River basin (USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset HUC8 subbasins) showing the planned classification of reaches into cold, transitional, and warm categories based on a modeled August stream-temperature dataset. This field component has not yet been carried out; no sampling coordinates are shown.

path.style: fill: #fbf3e3; stroke-dasharray: 4.8,2.4; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke: #c9973d; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter
